|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current full-face version; the current full-face version is [[Major Caluan Ematt (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-L-majorcaluanematt-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates identify full-face repository revisions and the printed edition of the slip; first publication of the partial is unknown. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-majorcaluanematt022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/majorcaluanematt.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/majorcaluanematt.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•General Dodonna”. Text: “May deploy -2 as a react to an [Episode VII] site. At the end of each turn, you must use 2 Force, lose 2 Force, or return Ematt to your hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Major Caluan Ematt (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-majorcaluanematta57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/majorcaluanematt.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/majorcaluanematt.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•General Dodonna” → “General Dodonna” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the later face encloses “react” in quotation marks. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “General Dodonna”. It is the current full-face image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “May deploy -2 as a 'react' to an [Episode VII] site. At the end of each turn, you must use 2 Force, lose 2 Force, or return Ematt to your hand.”

* '''Partial layout''' ([[Major Caluan Ematt (Errata 2)]]): the September 2023 sheet edition prints a art-cutout layout with the same current text. This is the third documented image (Errata 2); the source prints no errata mark. The image-version ordinal and absent printed mark are recorded in [[Players Committee transcription errors]].<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Official Set 7 sheet, September 2023 edition]], page 3.</ref> [[File:V7-L-majorcaluanematt-partial-layout-comparison-September-2023.png|thumb|center|500px|Full face and partial layout.]]
* The earlier full face prints react without quotation marks; the later full face and September 2023 partial print quotation marks around react. [[File:V7-L-majorcaluanematt-react-quotation-difference.png|thumb|center|500px|Unscaled source-pixel game-text crops.]]
